title: Ночные пирожные на кухне  (Late-Night Pastries in the Kitchen)

segments.t: After the evening shift, Fedya and Senya nudge Lyova to finally talk to his crush, the cleaner Gulya. When Lyova steps into the dark kitchen, he spots Ainura and Gulya packing leftover pastries.
У меня каждый раз сердце болит.
Мне тоже казалось, что шеф наблюдает.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
'Ainura, we really should not do this.' Claiming that they really should not do this sounds confident, even if Ainura has doubts.

'After all, this is real theft.' Pointing out that after all this is real theft gives Ainura a sobering reality check. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.

'What are you talking about?' Asking what Gulya talking is cuts straight through the tension between Ainura and Gulya. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'Now what Senya does—that is theft.' Realizing that what Senya does that is theft changes how Ainura handles the situation.
'Understand, these pastries will spoil by morning.' Even though Gulya should understand these pastries will spoil by morning, Ainura keeps a steady face in front of Gulya.
'They will simply throw them in the trash.' Even though they will simply throw them in the trash, Ainura keeps a steady face in front of Gulya.
У меня каждый раз сердце болит.
'My heart aches every single time.' Between the moment and the morning, Ainura gives Gulya a quick, grounded response.

'Taste for yourself how delicious it is.' Here tasting for themselves how delicious it is sets up the next turn in their exchange. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side.
'We will take a couple of pieces for the anniversary.' Once they will take a couple of pieces for the anniversary, Ainura can finally tell Gulya what she means.
'It seems to me someone is over there.' Adding that it seems to her someone is over there fills in the missing piece for Ainura.
Мне тоже казалось, что шеф наблюдает.
'It seemed to me too that the chef was watching.' Ainura tells Gulya that it seemed to her too that the was watching without dressing it up.

'She is over there all alone right now.' Since she is over there all alone right now, Lyova does not waste words on excuses. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
У меня каждый раз сердце болит.
Мне тоже казалось, что шеф наблюдает.
Instead of scolding Gulya, shy Lyova gets an idea for how to surprise her the next morning. Until next time!

lines.fragment: Ты пойми, эти пирожки утром испортятся
